newsitem.title: UKRAINE: TABLE - Ukraine 6-,9-,12-,18-mo T-bill yields down.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Ukraine 6-,9-,12-,18-mo T-bill yields down.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of Ukrainian six-month, nine-month, 12-month and 18-month treasury bills were down from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.

Six-month bills eased to 19.96 percent from 20.03 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 26.11 percent from 26.61 percent, 12-month bills slimmed to 26.96 percent from 27.53 percent, and 18-month bills fell to 30.46 from 31.97 percent.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction,
compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Auction Number 321 317
Issue date August 5, 1997 July 31, 1997
Maturity date February 4, 1998 January 30, 1998
Denominations 100 hryvnia 100 hryvnia
Issue volume 12.60 million UAH 12.40 million UAH
Amount sold 10.02 million UAH 2.54 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.11 million UAH 2.31 million UAH
Average yield 19.96 percent 20.03 percent
Average price 90.95 hryvnia 90.92 hryvnia
Cut-off price 90.92 hryvnia 90.92 hryvnia
The central bank sold 100,223 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
